name: Force Like
description: A creature resembling a Like Like, with different color variations.

fields.name: Color Variant
fields.description: Determines the color of the Force Like.

fields.name: Crawling Instead of Hiding
fields.description: When enabled, the Force Like crawls around above ground instead of hiding as a Force Crystal.

fields.name: Fall from Above
fields.description: When enabled, the Force Like falls from above when activated.

fields.name: Drop Items in Shadow World
fields.description: When enabled, dropped items appear in the Shadow World instead of the actor's current layer.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: The local variable that activates this actor.
